summary:
Detail Oriented Chartered Accountant with 1.5 years of pre-qualified experience (as paid assistant) in auditing, financial analysis, and regulatory compliance.
Proven ability to leverage analytical skills to enhance operational efficiency and support growth initiatives. Dedicated to ongoing professional development
and contributing to team success. Actively seeking opportunities to utilize skills in a dynamic work environment.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Quickbook→QuickBooks(95%), CompuBal.→CompuBal(94%), MS WORD→Microsoft Word(100%), financial analysis→Financial Analysis(100%))

bullets: Led end-to-end statutory and internal audits across the manufacturing, service, hospitality, and real estate sectors, ensuring adherence to applicable laws, regulations, auditing and accounting standards, internal control frameworks, and ICFR requirements.
Performed comprehensive risk assessment and engagement planning by defining audit scope, designing sampling methodologies, testing key financial and operational processes.

Evaluated the effectiveness of internal controls across procurement, revenue, inventory, payroll, HR compliance, cash/bank, and other operational processes; identified control gaps, non-compliances, and process weaknesses, and recommended measures to enhance reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Performed detailed audits of Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Related party transactions, and HR processes (including vendor onboarding, purchase orders, goods receipt, invoicing, payments, employee lifecycle, approval matrices, and segregation of duties), resulting in improvements in cost efficiency, approval workflows, and documentation standards.
Assessed IT general controls (ITGCs) and data security controls and accounting systems, data integrity, user access rights, backup procedures, and cybersecurity practices.
Prepared structured audit reports, and presented key observations and recommendations to management to support corrective and preventive actions and finalization of financial statements.

Developed 50+ SOPs and standardized workflows across HR, Finance, Procurement (P2P), O2C, Inventory, and IT functions. Taxation Department: Key Clients: Prakash Gold Industries, Bizflix Global, V Prakash Pump, Kazo International Pvt. Ltd.
Prepared and filed Income Tax Returns, Tax Audit Reports for individuals, firms, small businesses and companies to ensuring accuracy and timely compliance.
Drafted Appeals under Income Tax and GST and handled assessment.

Performed GST reconciliation (GSTR 2A/2B v/s Books) and prepared monthly/Quarterly GST returns (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B) for Individual & Companies. Legal Compliances and Other Work: Key Clients: NirogStreet Pvt. Ltd., Andor Communication, Aerobay India, Cyzen X Intelligence Etc.
Provided support in Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) (FCGPR and Swift Form) compliance and documentation.
Prepared and finalized financial statements, ensuring accurate reporting and insightful financial analysis.
Prepared projected and estimated financial statements for business planning and forecasting.
Ensured compliance with ROC regulations and handled ROC filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, ADT-1, DPT-3)
